No. 2418/44 – friday, january 10, 2025
The Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, hereby declare under Sub section (1) of the Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the lands described below are needed for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of the said Act.

The Six (06) land plots referred in detail by below names and in extents, in the Advance Tracing No. KU/KPW/2021/70, dated 07.05.2021 of the Surveyor General, situated in the Village of Labuyaya in the Grama Niladhari Division of No.1163-Thummodara of the Divisional Secretary's Division of Kuliyapitiya-West, in the District of Kurunegala, in the North Western Province.
01. Lot No. 1 – Not mention – Extent: 0.0284 Hectare North: East: South: Crown Land named
Mahanugalandawatta; West: Mahanugalandawatta claimed
by the Wayamba University of Sri Lanka and The Crown
Land named Mahanugalandawatta.
02. Lot No. 2 – Not mention – Extent: 0.0047 Hectare
North: Mahanugalandawatta claimed by the Wayamba
University of Sri Lanka; East: Crown Land named
Mahanugalandawatta; South: Road owned by Road
Development Authority; West: Crown Land named
Mahanugalandawatta and Mahanugalandawatta claimed by
the Wayamba University of Sri Lanka.

03. Lot No. 3 – Mahanugalandawatta – Extent: 1.9622 Hectare North: Crown Land named Mahanugalandawatta; East: Lot No. 04 of this tracing; South: Road owned by Road Development Authority; West: Crown Land named Mahanugalandawatta.
